text: In Genesis 22 the three days of travel are a kind of suspended sentence. Outwardly nothing happens; in significance everything happens. Faith, in this story, takes the form of a structured relation or arrangement, and feeling is not its chief matter. Obedience stands beside horror, and neither is allowed to prevail. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are named with care. The instruments of the act are present before the act itself occurs.
